title: Add region-aware streaming disconnect/error metrics and map to status components
author: Logan Wright
description: Context: As part of the status page transparency upgrades, we need streaming-specific signals that can be cleanly attributed to region and rolled up to public components (Hosted API > Streaming, per region). Today we have aggregate gateway error counts and some websocket-level counters, but they are not consistently labeled by region and do not distinguish client disconnects vs server-side stream aborts/timeouts, which has led to slow/incorrect status updates (see SUP-28549 and the 2025-11-07 US-East streaming degradation follow-ups). This PR adds region-aware counters for streaming failures/disconnects, standardizes label keys (region, capability=streaming, component_id), and documents how these metrics roll up into the status component health views used by on-call and incident-bot drafts. Scope: 1) Emit new metrics from the streaming path (SSE + websocket) with consistent region labeling (derived from edge ingress / routing layer). 2) Separate failure modes: client_disconnect (EOF/close), server_abort (upstream canceled), stream_timeout, and internal_error. 3) Add an aggregator helper to compute a per-region streaming error rate suitable for dashboards/alerts. 4) Add docs: what counts toward customer-facing status signals and how to interpret disconnect spikes (e.g., client disconnects should generally not drive status unless correlated with elevated server_abort/internal_error). Non-goals: changing alert thresholds or status automation behavior in this PR (that stays in observability-pack / slo-toolkit), and no changes to public status page component registry. Testing: unit tests for label derivation and error classification; integration smoke in staging with a forced upstream cancel; verified metrics presence in Prometheus and cardinality bounds in the metrics lint job. Rollout: safe to deploy behind existing runtime; metrics are additive; dashboards/alerts will be updated in follow-on PRs.
commits: metrics(streaming): add region-aware counters for stream failures/disconnects
metrics(streaming): classify disconnect vs server abort vs timeout
routing: plumb region into stream handler context
docs(observability): define rollup rules for status component 'Hosted API > Streaming'
tests: add coverage for label sets and classification edge cases
chore: register new metric names with metrics linter allowlist
review_conversation: Allison Grant (review): The separation of client_disconnect vs server_abort is good. We should be explicit in docs that client_disconnect should not page SRE by itself. Also can we ensure region is taken from the same source as status component routing (Mina's taxonomy)? Logan Wright (author): Added a note in the rollup doc: client_disconnect is informational and only used when correlated with server_abort/internal_error. For region, we now derive from routing context (edge-selected region) and fall back to 'unknown' (dropped from rollups) to avoid mis-attribution. Mina Haddad (review): Concern about adding region as a label on high-QPS metrics. What is the expected cardinality? Logan Wright (author): Regions are bounded (us-east, us-west, eu-west, ap-sg currently; plus 'unknown'). Added a metrics-lint cardinality rule limiting region label values to the region allowlist; test fixture updated. Aisha Bello (review): Can we add a helper function for computing error rate that matches the dashboard query we plan to use? Also, please align label keys with slo-toolkit (component_id vs component). Logan Wright (author): Added computeStreamingErrorRate() helper and standardized on component_id/region/capability keys; left a note in docs that dashboards should query by those labels. Christine Wong (review): Please add an explicit mapping note: Hosted API > Streaming (per region) is driven by server_abort + internal_error + timeout rate over total streams, not client disconnects. Logan Wright (author): Updated docs with the exact rollup formula and example PromQL query. Allison Grant (final): Approved after docs clarifications + cardinality guardrails.
release_notes: Added region-aware streaming disconnect/error metrics (SSE/websocket) with standardized labels (component_id, region, capability) and documented rollup rules for Hosted API > Streaming status component health views.
notes: Follow-ups: (1) Update dashboards to use the new metrics and rollup helper (observability-pack). (2) Add component-level burn alerts keyed on Hosted API > Streaming per region (slo-toolkit). (3) Wire incident-bot draft templates to include streaming failure mode breakdown when available.
